CHITKARAU – AN EDUCATIONAL EXPERIENCE OF MIND & SPIRIT.
COME, EXPLORE YOUR POTENTIAL 
 
We are nestled at the foothills of the mighty Himalayas in the most planned, secure, and
beautiful city of Chandigarh, designed by French Architect Le Corbusier, with two spectacular
campuses. The city boasts of a dense green cover, easy accessibility by air, road, and rail, and
sumptuous Indian and Western cuisines from all parts of India and the world. Yoga, mindfulness,
and meditation are practiced at the campus with unforgettable trips in the Himalayas, and so
much more. This brochure is a window to all the opportunities India and Chitkara University will
throw up for you. Come explore us, and your Potential

The Golden Temple in Amritsar, officially Harmandir Sahib, is Sikhism’s holiest shrine and a
masterpiece of sacred architecture. Nestled within a shimmering man-made pool called the Amrit
Sarovar, its gilded façade and marble inlays reflect the devotion of generations. Pilgrims and visitors of
all faiths come to offer prayers, listen to continuous recitation of the Guru Granth Sahib, and partake
in the langar, a free community meal served to thousands daily. The temple’s peaceful atmosphere,
historic significance, and commitment to equality and service make it a symbol of spiritual solace and
communal harmony in India, welcoming seekers from everywhere.

TANTALIZE YOUR TASTE
BUDS 
INDIAN CUISINE

diverse Indian cuisines in
our culinary sessions!

REJUVENATE

BODY MIND
and soul
Join our refreshing campus
yoga sessions for balance and
energy!

WE ARE AT THE FOREFRONT OF INTERNATIONAL ENGAGEMENT & PARTNERSHIPS
 
Name any part of the World, and we send and receive students. From North America to Europe,
the Middle East to Southeast Asia, from Japan & Korea to down under Australia, our students go
everywhere, and we welcome their students to Chitkara University. Chandigarh is the most well-
planned, secure, and non-polluted Indian city in the foothills of the Himalayas, where our
international students and faculty love to keep coming back. 
Chitkara University offers a diverse range of programs in Engineering, Business, Pharmacy, Health
Sciences, Design, Media, Hospitality, Education, Law, and more. With a student-centric approach,
the university ensures holistic development by combining academic rigor with practical exposure,
entrepreneurship, and skill enhancement. 
 
Our experiential learning is not just limited to academic education but a holistic one that engages
and rejuvenates your mind and body alike. From Yoga to Meditation, trekking and soul searching
trips in the upper reaches of the Himalayas, students experience a vibe and energy of India that it
has represented for centuries. Besides, you will be welcomed to learn and indulge in vibrant and
lip-smacking Indian cuisines from diverse parts of India, and create some lifelong relationships with
our community that could be a bedrock support for life. 
 
You can come to us for a short mobility or a semester or global internships, we abide by our motto
‘Athithi Devo Bhava’, which simply translates to our guests are our Gods. Come, experience our
Hospitality and grow in your mind and spirit at Chitkara University
